en-US:
# DashCam v1.0.0
Advanced dashcam app for old Android phones: video recording, impact detection, GPS telemetry, cloud upload.
**Features:** AUTO/Per Trip/Timed recording modes, accelerometer impact detection, Google Drive/OneDrive/SMB upload, multi-language UI.
**Requirements:** Android 8.0+, camera, GPS, accelerometer, storage space.
Install APK and grant permissions.
*Released: 11/3/2025 - Version 1.0.0*
